gaps.sentence: He acted on his own ___ and did not ask permission.
gaps.hint: on your own ___ = without being told
gaps.explanation: 'On one's own initiative' = deciding and acting independently.

gaps.sentence: I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.

gaps.sentence: The matter went completely ___ my head — I cannot recall a thing.
gaps.explanation: 'Over one's head' = too complicated to understand.

gaps.sentence: We spoke ___ the phone for an hour.
The soldiers were ___ of danger once they had crossed the river.
gaps.explanation: 'Out of danger' = no longer at risk.

gaps.sentence: Everything was left ___ the care of the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: 'in the care of' = looked after by.

gaps.sentence: The climbers were well ___ of schedule by midday.
___ any rate, we still have enough time.
gaps.explanation: 'At any rate' = whatever else is true.
